entries.name: Bodyweight Squat
entries.summary: Three drawn positions of a bodyweight squat, seen from the side.

provenance.positions: Authored for this repository from its own curated execution instructions and coaching cues for movement_id 28 (packages/core-db/src/schema/010_movement_library.sql, 025_movement_coaching_content.sql).
instructionAgreement: stand — "Stand with the feet around shoulder width and toes turned to a comfortable angle."
descent — "Sit between the hips while the knees track with the toes."
bottom — "pressure stays across the whole foot"; depth drawn at thighs near parallel, the range the instructions call owned.
provenance.artwork: No third-party artwork. Every frame is a list of joint coordinates in this file, drawn at runtime from plain React Native views.
provenance.licence: Original work created for this repository; covered by the repository licence.

entries.reviewNotes: Side view only. The drawing shows depth, foot pressure and knee tracking; it cannot show breathing, bracing or individual hip anatomy. No qualified technique reviewer has signed this off yet.
entries.limitations: Three frames cannot show tempo or the failure modes the instructions warn about (heels lifting, chest folding). The text instructions remain the authority.

frames.caption: Stand tall, feet about shoulder width, pressure across the whole foot
Sit between the hips; the knees track out with the toes
Thighs near parallel, chest tall, whole foot still rooted

entries.reason: Authored coordinate prototype with canonical 11-joint topology and front-held implement awaiti.

frames.caption: Hold one dumbbell or kettlebell close to the chest with the forearms supporting it.
Stand around shoulder width with the toes turned to a comfortable angle.
Sit between the hips and keep the chest tall.
Drive through the whole foot and sit tall between the hips.
Keep the load close to the chest with pressure across the whole foot.

entries.summary: Five drawn positions of a goblet squat, seen from the side.

entries.name: Dumbbell Squat
techniqueCitations: Haff, G. G., & Triplett, N. T. (Eds.). (2016). Essentials of Strength Training and Conditioning (4th ed.). Human Kinetics, pp. 360-363.
entries.reason: Own drawn frames authored for this repository after owner review found the first draft off centre with its weight behind the feet: a neutral upright start with the feet under the hips, the squat path kept between the ankles, and a dumbbell hung plumb beside each hand so it reads held at the side of the leg rather than as a bar across the hip. Draft preview pending qualified technique review.

frames.caption: Stand tall with the dumbbells hanging at your sides.
Sit down between the hips and let the dumbbells travel straight down beside you.
Keep the chest tall as the hips sink back and down, dumbbells plumb.
Squat until your thighs are near parallel, the dumbbells hanging plumb at your sides.
Drive up through the whole foot with a tall chest.
Rise tall, hips and shoulders coming up together.
Stand tall again with the whole foot on the floor and the dumbbells at your sides.

entries.summary: Seven drawn positions of a dumbbell squat, seen from the side.

entries.name: Competition Squat
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 32 degrees so stance width, knee direction, trunk lean, and upper-back bar placement all read together: standing in front of a squat rack with the barbell across the upper back and the whole foot rooted, descending until the hip crease passes the top of the knee, and driving back to standing while the bar stays over mid-foot.
entries.summary: With the barbell set securely across the upper back and the whole foot rooted, brace and descend until the hip crease passes the top of the knee, then drive back to standing while the bar stays over mid-foot.

frames.caption: Set the bar securely, brace, and walk it out with the fewest controlled steps needed.
Root the whole foot and descend toward competition depth.
Descend until the hip crease passes the top of the knee.
Drive back to standing while the bar stays over mid-foot.
Brace before the walkout, root the whole foot, and drive the back into the bar.

entries.name: Narrow Stance Squats
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 32 degrees so the narrow stance and forward knee travel can be compared directly with the other back-rack squats: feet set narrower than shoulder width with the barbell across the upper back, letting the knees travel forward over the toes as the hips sit down to a deep squat, and pushing the floor away to stand.
entries.summary: With the bar across the upper back and a stance narrower than shoulder width, brace and let the knees travel forward over the toes as the hips sit down into a deep squat, then push the floor away to stand.

frames.caption: Set the bar across the upper back and step into a stance narrower than shoulder width with the toes turned slightly out.
Brace and let the knees travel forward as the hips sit down.
Keep pressure across the whole foot to the deepest position you own.
Push the floor away to stand.
Root the whole foot, send the knees forward over the toes, and drive straight up under the bar.

entries.name: Squat with Bands
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 32 degrees so the wide stance, outward knee tracking, and floor-anchored bands on both bar ends show: standing in a squat rack with bands attached from the ends of the bar to a secure anchor near the floor, descending in a wide stance with the knees pushed out until the hip crease is level with the top of the knee, and driving up against the band tension.
entries.summary: With bands attached from the ends of the bar to an anchor near the floor and a wide stance, push the knees out and sit the hips back and down until the hip crease is level with the top of the knee, then drive through the feet to stand tall.

frames.caption: Attach bands from the ends of the bar to a secure anchor near the floor, take the bar across the back of the shoulders with the shoulder blades squeezed together, and step back into a wide stance.
With the trunk tight, push the knees out and sit the hips back and down.
Descend until the hip crease is level with the top of the knee.
Drive through the feet, keeping the knees out, to stand tall against the band tension.
Shoulder blades squeezed together, knees out, hips back, and stay tight from head to toe.

entries.name: Wide Stance Barbell Squat
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 32 degrees so the wide stance and knees tracking over the toes read beside the standard and narrow back-rack squats: barbell across the upper back, feet set wider than the shoulders, keeping the chest up and back straight while lowering until the thighs are just below level with the floor, and driving through the feet to stand.
entries.summary: With the bar across the upper back and a stance wider than the shoulders, keep the chest up and back straight while lowering until the thighs are just below level with the floor, then drive through the feet to stand.

frames.caption: Take the bar from the rack across the upper back and step back into a stance wider than the shoulders with the toes turned slightly out.
Keeping the chest up and the back straight, bend the knees and lower.
Lower until the thighs are just below level with the floor.
Drive through the feet to stand back up.
Chest up, back straight, knees track over the toes, and drive through the whole foot.

entries.name: Front Squat
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 10 degrees so the horizontal upper arms pointing forward, the bar resting on the front of the shoulders, and the upright torso read clearly without an end-on plate covering the shoulder: barbell set across the front of the shoulders with a secure grip slightly wider than shoulder width and the elbows pointing forward, squatting between the hips with the upper arms kept horizontal and the elbows high, and driving back to standing with the bar over mid-foot.
entries.summary: With the bar across the front of the shoulders in a secure grip and the elbows pointing forward, squat between the hips while keeping the elbows high, then drive back to standing with the bar over mid-foot.

frames.caption: Set the bar across the front of the shoulders with a secure grip and the elbows pointing forward.
Stand around shoulder width, root the whole foot, and keep the elbows high before descending.
Squat between the hips with the elbows kept high.
Drive back to standing with the bar over mid-foot.
Drive the elbows forward and high, root the whole foot, and stay tall through the drive.

entries.name: Front Squat (Clean Grip)
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 10 degrees so it can be compared side by side with Front Squat: rack J-hooks set visibly below standing shoulder height, hands just outside the shoulders (narrower than Front Squat) with the barbell resting on the front of the shoulders, a magnified close-up panel of the near hand showing the open hand with the fingertips under the bar, elbows held higher than Front Squat throughout the squat, sitting straight down between the legs with the chest up, and driving through the middle of the feet to stand.
entries.summary: With the bar set in a rack just below shoulder height and resting on the front of the shoulders with the fingertips under the bar and the elbows high, sit straight down between the legs, then drive through the middle of the feet to stand.

frames.caption: Set the bar in a rack just below shoulder height, rest it on the front of the shoulders with the fingertips under the bar and the elbows high, then step back with the feet shoulder-width apart.
Keeping the elbows and chest up, bend the knees and sit straight down between the legs.
Sit straight down between the legs as deep as you can control.
Drive through the middle of the feet to stand back up.
Elbows high, chest up, sit straight down, and let the knees track over the toes.

entries.name: Box Squat
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 30 degrees so the box behind the athlete, the backward hip travel, the near-vertical shins, and the stance width all show: barbell across the upper back, sitting the hips back onto the box at parallel height with the shins near vertical, pausing briefly on the box without relaxing, and driving back up to standing without rocking forward.
entries.summary: With a box behind you at parallel height and the bar across the upper back, sit back onto the box under control with the shins near vertical, pause briefly without relaxing, then drive back up to standing.

frames.caption: Set a box behind you at or just below parallel height and set up as for a back squat.
Sit back onto the box under control with the shins near vertical.
Pause briefly on the box without relaxing.
Drive back up to standing without rocking forward.
Sit back with the shins near vertical, stay tight through the pause, and explode up off the box.

entries.name: Reverse Band Box Squat
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 30 degrees so the power rack overhead frame, the bands hanging from the top of the rack to the barbell ends, the wide stance, and the box contact all read together: sitting the hips back onto the box with near-vertical shins while the overhead bands lengthen to help most at the bottom, pausing seated on the box while staying tight, and driving up with the knees out.
entries.summary: Inside a rack with bands hung from the top and looped around the bar ends, push the knees out and sit the hips back until seated on the box, pause while staying tight, then drive through the feet to stand up off the box.

frames.caption: Inside a rack, hang bands from the top and loop them around the bar, set a box behind you, take the bar across the back of the shoulders, and step back.
With the trunk tight, push the knees out and sit the hips back onto the box under control.
Pause seated on the box while staying tight.
Drive through the feet with the knees out to stand up off the box.
Sit back onto the box under control, pause on the box, stay tight, and drive up with the knees out.

entries.name: Speed Box Squat
entries.reason: Source-bound draft, drawn from a 3D model turned 30 degrees so it pairs directly with Box Squat and Reverse Band Box Squat: bands anchored near the floor and looped over the ends of the bar, sitting the hips back onto the box with near-vertical shins on a controlled 1350 ms descent, a brief 350 ms pause seated on the box, and a fast 650 ms concentric drive up off the box against band tension.
entries.summary: With bands anchored near the floor and looped over the ends of the bar and a box behind you, sit the hips back under control onto the box, pause briefly, and drive up off the box as fast as you can.

frames.caption: Anchor bands near the floor and loop them over the ends of the bar, set a box behind you, take the bar across the upper back with the shoulder blades pulled together, and step back.
Sit the hips back under control until you are seated on the box.
Pause briefly on the box while staying tight.
Drive up off the box as fast as you can while staying tight.
Sit back onto the box under control, pause, stay tight, and stand up fast.
